reviews.review: An insanely addictive and massively enjoyable experience that builds upon everything that made it's predecessor the masterpiece that it is. Tied with Kenshi for best soundtrack to any game I've ever personally experienced. Highly recommend playing with a buddy.

Let me start by saying: no game has quite matched the intensity, intrigue and mystique this game has. The story, the feel, the atmosphere is perfect.  You don't need either of the DLC's to have 100s of hours of content to play. 


Survivors of the Void: Amazing DLC that adds tons upon the already otherworldly amount of content the game has, featuring two new survivors that both fit the game perfectly. Void items are harsh and interesting, of course some are better than others but they're balanced very well. Adds a new boss + stages.

Seekers of the Storm: Well... It's gearbox. If you like gearbox, feel free. Just know that they gearbox'd, mike'd, dare I say: bastardized the game..? Cause they did. The one good thing from this is the music, there's a random comment I like to quote from an obscure YT video, it being: 


"I find it kind of hilarious how common a thing it is in the games industry for every important aspect of the dev team goes entirely to ♥♥♥♥, with the sound team being the only people left who have any idea what they're doing."

Especially true for Chris.

Overall, just get the base game and SotV.

Edit* Take-Two EULA is blanket "feature" for all "gearbox" games. As someone who bought and played this game years before the acquisition: it was much, much better before gearbox.

Add the new EULA on top, FUBAR. Good job gearbox, you did it again.

This is one of my all time favorite games, the first entry in the series was fun and had a captivating art style. This took a solid foundation and turned it into one of the best 3D Rogue-likes ever! Most rogue-likes give you a small amount of very strong or unique items, while RoR2 gives you the ability to stack large quantities of very minor and stat enhancing items to greater effects. That being said there are some pretty rare items that are very powerful and unique. The highlight though is stacking large amounts of let's say sticky bombs which gives your attacks the ability to attach, you guessed it sticky bombs to your foes. Getting enough of them turns foes into giant mass of little bombs which can also clear a great deal of enemies around them. I would highly recommend this game if you enjoy 3rd person action games, Rogue-likes, and/or really great co-op games.
